structured.approach: I read feat.tasks to find this lane's tasks, TSK-03 and TSK-04 in ap_forecast. org.permission_table is restricted, so I used it only through the tool view (tool:repo-access), which says no secrets are required or granted for ap_forecast. To check that nothing needs a credential, I read every source file in ap_forecast (predict.py, explain.py, models.json, __init__.py), the existing test file and ci.py. None of them reads a credential or an environment variable, and none sends a network request. Every environment row now cites only what feat.tasks section 2 and the tool view state. I used no connector, because the lane adds no dependencies.

claims.text: The Data Science lane covers TSK-03 (STORY-03) and TSK-04 (STORY-04) in the ap_forecast repository.
The permission table requires and grants no secrets for ap_forecast.
TSK-03 is rule-based. It uses no LLM, no network and no models.json read, and risk.py imports only predict_delay_days.
TSK-04 keeps the provider, model and max_tokens source (config or load_config()) and models.json unchanged. Sending the label to acme-llm waits on TQ-8, which gates release, not coding.
build_explanation_request imports only json and pathlib, reads models.json and returns a request dict without sending it.
models.json names provider acme-llm and model acme-text-2 and holds no key or endpoint.
predict.py uses only statistics.mean and typing.Iterable. __init__.py only re-exports the two functions.
The existing tests and the CI script need no credential or live provider.
The feature/<story>, dev (integration) and main (released) environments require no secrets and are granted none, so no access request is raised.

open_questions: SSQ-1 (non-blocking): Which component sends the build_explanation_request payload to acme-llm, and who owns its credential? This is outside TSK-03 and TSK-04. If ap_forecast ever calls the provider directly, DS-02 must be re-entered.
structured.summary: I rewrote task.secrets_scope.md for FEAT-ZD-48600. The Data Science tasks TSK-03 and TSK-04 in ap_forecast need no secrets in CI, feature/<story>, dev or main, and the permission table grants none. Required and granted access match, both empty, so no access request was raised. Reading every source file confirmed there are no credential reads and no outbound calls. One non-blocking question (SSQ-1) asks who owns the acme-llm credential.
